facts.guard: regulatory class is not network capacity or project delivery

facts.network_definition: central source serving more than one property or building
facts.guard: scope and deadline do not prove a site is connected

scope_guards: Potential zoning and designated zoning remain distinct.
A five-year pipeline is not a funded or constructed network.
Registration scope is not evidence of site connection.
Operator and supplier roles remain distinct.
Metering classification does not establish network capacity.
Ofgem authorisation is not planning permission or a supply contract.
Future registration deadlines are not applied as completed status.
Exact zone, operator, connection, capacity and planning evidence is required.
